paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира сравнение на средните абсолютни стойности на скритите състояния във вътрешните слоеве на модел, като се сравняват три конфигурации: преди пропускане (pre-gating), след пропускане (post-gating) и базова (baseline). Осата X е обозначена като „Layer“ и показва номерата на слоевете, като скалата е линейна с диапазон от 0 до 25. Етикетите са разположени с интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25). Осата Y е обозначена като „Abs Mean“ и представлява средната абсолютна стойност на скритите състояния; скалата е линейна с диапазон от 0 до 4, с етикети на всеки 1 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).  

Синята пунктирана линия, означаваща „hidden state mean before gate“, започва със стойност около 0.2 при слой 0, се повишава леко до около 0.4 при слой 2, след което остава близо до 0.5 до слой 15, след което рязко се повишава до пик от около 2.8 при слой 23, преди да достигне стойност около 4.3 при слой 25. Оранжевата пунктирана линия, означаваща „hidden state mean after gate“, започва със стойност около 0.01 при слой 0 и остава близо до 0.03 през целия диапазон, с леко повишаване до около 0.04 при слой 25. Зелената сплошна линия, означаваща „hidden state mean of baseline“, започва със стойност около 0.01 при слой 0 и остава близо до 0.02 до слой 15, след което се повишава леко до около 0.04 при слой 25. Всички три линии са изобразени в една и съща координатна система.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three configurations: pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 25 in integer increments, while the y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," shows the mean absolute value of hidden states, scaled from 0 to 4. The blue dashed line, representing the "hidden state mean before gate," starts at a value of approximately 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively stable near 0.2 until layer 15, then increases sharply, reaching a peak of approximately 2.8 at layer 23 before rising to about 4.3 at layer 25. The orange dotted line, indicating the "hidden state mean after gate," begins near 0.02 at layer 0 and stays consistently close to zero, with a slight increase to about 0.05 at layer 25. The green solid line, corresponding to the "hidden state mean of baseline," also starts near 0.02 and remains close to zero, showing a marginal increase to approximately 0.05 at layer 25. All three lines exhibit low values in the initial layers, with the pre-gating mean showing a significant upward trend in deeper layers, while the post-gating and baseline means remain nearly flat.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three configurations: pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 23, while the y-axis shows the absolute mean of hidden states. The blue dashed line, representing the hidden state mean before the gate (average 0.71), starts near zero, remains relatively flat through layer 15, and then increases sharply, peaking at approximately 2.8 at layer 23. In contrast, the orange dotted line (hidden state mean after gate, average 0.05) and the green solid line (baseline mean, average 0.04) both remain close to zero across all layers, with the baseline showing slightly higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. This sharp rise in the pre-gating mean beginning around layer 12 indicates that the gating mechanism effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die mittleren absoluten Werte der versteckten Zustände über die Schichten eines Modells und vergleicht drei Konfigurationen: vor dem Gating, nach dem Gating und die Baseline. Die x-Achse, beschriftet mit „Layer“, ist linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 23 mit numerischen Beschriftungen in Abständen von 5. Die y-Achse, beschriftet mit „Abs Mean“, ist ebenfalls linear und umfasst den Bereich von 0 bis 4 mit Beschriftungen in Abständen von 1. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie, die den „hidden state mean before gate“ darstellt (durchschnittlich 0.71), beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0.1 bei Layer 0, bleibt bis Layer 15 nahe bei 0.2 und steigt dann stark an, um bei Layer 23 einen Höhepunkt von etwa 2.8 zu erreichen. Die orange punktierte Linie, die den „hidden state mean after gate“ repräsentiert (durchschnittlich 0.05), verläuft nahe bei 0, beginnt bei etwa 0.02 bei Layer 0 und bleibt bis Layer 23 unter 0.05, mit einem leichten Anstieg in den letzten Schichten. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie, die den „hidden state mean of baseline“ zeigt (durchschnittlich 0.04), beginnt bei etwa 0.01 bei Layer 0, bleibt überwiegend unter 0.05 und erreicht bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 0.06. Alle drei Linien zeigen überwiegend flache Verläufe, wobei die blau gestrichelte Linie im Bereich ab Layer 12 einen deutlichen Anstieg aufweist.
